conventions.interpolation: piecewise linear in log-moneyness and maturity on total variance; no extrapolation
conventions.pricing: forward-normalized undiscounted Black call, then multiplied by discountFactor * forward
conventions.arbitrage: discrete diagnostics on submitted nodes; not a proof between nodes

limitations: Educational deterministic surface-quality analysis; inputs are user assumptions or a labelled fixture, never live quotes.
Diagnostics are discrete necessary checks on submitted nodes, not a continuous global arbitrage proof.
Interpolation is inside the rectangular grid only; no extrapolation, smoothing, sorting, filling or clipping is performed.
No SVI/SABR/Heston calibration, Dupire local volatility, stochastic rates, dividends, American exercise or trading signal is inferred.
